description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for the Gateway authentication in the Eclipse Ditto project, including methods to retrieve HTTP proxy configurations, OAuth configurations, and flags for pre-authentication and dummy authentication. It also includes an enumeration for default configuration values related to authentication.

classes.name: AuthenticationConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration settings for gateway authentication, including HTTP proxy settings, OAuth config, and flags for pre-authentication and dummy authentication, along with an enum for default config values.

classes.name: AuthenticationConfig.AuthenticationConfigValue
classes.description: An enum representing known configuration path expressions and their default values for authentication settings.

methods.name: getHttpProxyConfig
methods.description: Returns the HTTP proxy configuration settings.

methods.name: isPreAuthenticationEnabled
methods.description: Checks if pre-authenticated authentication is enabled.

methods.name: isDummyAuthenticationEnabled
methods.description: Checks if dummy authentication is enabled (deprecated).

methods.name: getDevOpsConfig
methods.description: Returns the DevOps resource configuration settings.
